lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr4Al4Fe16 (ZrAlFe4) adopts the cubic F-43m space group (No. 216) with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Al and Zr centers each surrounded by 12 Fe neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Fe centers have 10 geometric neighbors (4 Al, 2 Fe, 4 Zr). The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Fe-centered 10-vertex polyhedra, plus corner and face sharing between Al- and Zr-centered 12-vertex polyhedra.
